A mysterious giant jaw-like structure has been discovered near the Narmada River in Patai village, Raisen, Madhya Pradesh. The unusual structure was found by children while digging near Patai Ghat on November 10. It reportedly has 18 tooth-like projections, raising speculation that it could belong to a prehistoric animal. Some villagers have started worshipping it, believing it to be a divine form. Authorities have directed officials to protect the site, while experts will investigate its origin and identity. The fossil theory remains unconfirmed.
